definition.causal_prescription: Im z>0: forward support toward decreasing rho, zero above source; Im z<0: reverse support, zero below source
definition.convention: (H-z)^-1=i integral_0^infinity exp(i z t)exp(-iHt)dt in upper half-plane; not directly the -i theta convention without its sign conversion
definition.domain: actual whole-line transmitted PG Dirac domain; computations restricted to strictly trapped [-1,1], using causal support, not walls
definition.kernel_generator: K(z)=R_packet(z)^-1; K_cp is an energy-dependent inverse-response cross kernel
definition.not_evaluated: numeric response from the asymptotically exterior parent region or through a singular stationary horizon chart
definition.packet_response: R_packet=J^dagger R J, J=[f_parent I2,f_child I2]; order parent,child
definition.probe_roles: normalized L2 source/measurement functions in D(H), not a physical initial state or new particle sector
definition.probes: fp=sqrt(30)*rho*(1-rho) on (0,1); fc=fp(-rho) on (-1,0); zero elsewhere
definition.route: B: whole-line boundary-resolvent, then normalized packet compression

delta_accounting.cancellation: u_parent(0)=u_child(0), including metric sensitivities; they cancel before projection of the full solution
delta_accounting.individual_terms: i v0 u(0) delta from P_child and its opposite from P_parent are nonzero

metric_derivative.CTP_bridge: requires the time/spectral reconstruction of the full history response and its state/memory data; a static packet resolvent derivative is not a unitary dU
metric_derivative.functional: delta R_packet=sum_A integral s_A(rho) J_A(rho;z)d rho for smooth compact variations in (-1,1)
metric_derivative.kernel: J_A=i/2[L^dagger V_A U_prime-L_prime^dagger V_A U]-L^dagger M_A U; U=R(z)J, L=R(z*)J
metric_derivative.numeric_direction: s=exp(1-1/(1-rho²)) inside |rho|<1, zero outside; no metric history or fitted deformation
